print(len(lines))
# backtrack choose lines degree 3 exactly

deg={p:0 for p in pts}
chosen=[]

def search(start=0):
    # find p with deg<3 and min available lines not decided? We'll use exact cover algorithm allowing index to avoid duplicates.
    if all(deg[p]==3 for p in pts):
        return True
    # choose point with deg<3 minimal candidate lines that don't exceed deg
    bestp=None; cand=None
    for p in pts:
        if deg[p]<3:
            cs=[i for i,L in enumerate(lines) if p in L and i not in chosen and all(deg[q]<3 for q in L)]
            # But can also choose lines not containing p before later; not need index.
            if bestp is None or len(cs)<len(cand): bestp=p; cand=cs
    # try candidate
    for i in cand:
        L=lines[i]
        if any(deg[q]>=3 for q in L): continue
        chosen.append(i)
        for q in L: deg[q]+=1
        # pruning: each p can still reach 3 using available nonchosen lines no overflow
        ok=True
        for p in pts:
            if deg[p]>3: ok=False; break
            rem=sum(1 for j,L2 in enumerate(lines) if j not in chosen and p in L2 and all(deg[q]<3 for q in L2))
            if deg[p]+rem<3: ok=False; break
        if ok and search(): return True
        for q in L: deg[q]-=1
        chosen.pop()
    return False
